faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About HouseViz AI
faq.description: Have another question? Contact us or schedule a demo to learn more.

items.title: How accurate is the sunlight analysis?
items.description: HouseViz AI uses advanced algorithms and real-time solar position calculations to provide highly accurate sunlight analysis. Our system accounts for building geometry, seasonal variations, and local weather patterns to deliver precise results you can trust.

items.title: Can I analyze any property worldwide?
items.description: Yes! HouseViz AI works globally using open-source mapping data and our proprietary algorithms. We cover major cities across 25+ countries, and our system intelligently handles data gaps by allowing manual input for the most accurate results.

items.title: How long does it take to generate a property report?
items.description: Basic 3D visualization and sunlight analysis takes about 30 seconds. Full AI-powered reports with neighborhood insights and recommendations are typically ready within 2-3 minutes, depending on property complexity.

items.title: Do you integrate with real estate platforms?
items.description: Absolutely! HouseViz AI integrates with popular CRM systems and real estate platforms. We support API connections for bulk analysis and can customize integrations based on your specific workflow needs.

items.title: Is my property data secure and private?
items.description: Yes, we take data security seriously. All property analysis data is encrypted, and we only store information with your explicit consent. We never share or sell your data, and you maintain full control over your reports and analyses.

items.title: Can I use this for commercial properties?
items.description: Definitely! HouseViz AI works great for commercial properties too. Our analysis helps with office leasing decisions, retail location planning, and commercial real estate investments by providing detailed sunlight and location intelligence.
